#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int MOD1 = 998244353;

class AvlTree {
private:
    struct TreeNode {
        int key, value;
        TreeNode *left, *right, *parent;
        int height, num_left, num_total;
        TreeNode(int k, int v) : key(k), value(v), left(nullptr), right(nullptr), parent(nullptr), height(1), num_left(1), num_total(1) {}
    };

    TreeNode* _tree;

    static int getHeight(TreeNode* x) {
        return x ? x->height : 0;
    }

    static int getNumTotal(TreeNode* x) {
        return x ? x->num_total : 0;
    }

    TreeNode* _add(int k, int v) {
        TreeNode* node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (k < node->key) {
                if (node->left) {
                    node = node->left;
                } else {
                    node->left = new TreeNode(k, v);
                    node->left->parent = node;
                    return node->left;
                }
            } else if (node->key < k) {
                if (node->right) {
                    node = node->right;
                } else {
                    node->right = new TreeNode(k, v);
                    node->right->parent = node;
                    return node->right;
                }
            } else {
                node->value = v;
                return nullptr;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    void _rebalance(TreeNode* node) {
        TreeNode* n = node;
        while (n) {
            int lh = getHeight(n->left);
            int rh = getHeight(n->right);
            n->height = max(lh, rh) + 1;
            int balance_factor = lh - rh;
            n->num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(n->left) + getNumTotal(n->right);
            n->num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(n->left);
            if (balance_factor > 1) {
                if (getHeight(n->left->left) < getHeight(n->left->right)) {
                    _rotateLeft(n->left);
                }
                _rotateRight(n);
            } else if (balance_factor < -1) {
                if (getHeight(n->right->right) < getHeight(n->right->left)) {
                    _rotateRight(n->right);
                }
                _rotateLeft(n);
            } else {
                n = n->parent;
            }
        }
    }

    static bool _isLeft(TreeNode* node) {
        return node->parent && node->parent->left == node;
    }

    static bool _isLeaf(TreeNode* node) {
        return !node->left && !node->right;
    }

    void _removeOne(TreeNode* node) {
        TreeNode* replacement = node->left ? node->left : node->right;
        if (node->parent) {
            if (_isLeft(node)) {
                node->parent->left = replacement;
            } else {
                node->parent->right = replacement;
            }
            replacement->parent = node->parent;
            node->parent = nullptr;
        } else {
            _tree = replacement;
            replacement->parent = nullptr;
        }
        node->left = node->right = node->parent = nullptr;
        _rebalance(replacement);
    }

    void _removeLeaf(TreeNode* node) {
        if (node->parent) {
            if (_isLeft(node)) {
                node->parent->left = nullptr;
            } else {
                node->parent->right = nullptr;
            }
            _rebalance(node->parent);
        } else {
            _tree = nullptr;
        }
        node->parent = node->left = node->right = nullptr;
    }

    TreeNode* _getNode(int k) {
        if (!_tree) return nullptr;
        TreeNode* node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (k < node->key) {
                node = node->left;
            } else if (node->key < k) {
                node = node->right;
            } else {
                return node;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    static TreeNode* _getNext(TreeNode* node) {
        if (!node->right) return node->parent;
        TreeNode* n = node->right;
        while (n->left) n = n->left;
        return n;
    }

    void _rotateRight(TreeNode* node) {
        if (!node->parent) {
            _tree = node->left;
            node->left->parent = nullptr;
        } else if (_isLeft(node)) {
            node->parent->left = node->left;
            node->left->parent = node->parent;
        } else {
            node->parent->right = node->left;
            node->left->parent = node->parent;
        }
        TreeNode* bk = node->left->right;
        node->left->right = node;
        node->parent = node->left;
        node->left = bk;
        if (bk) bk->parent = node;
        node->height = max(getHeight(node->left), getHeight(node->right)) + 1;
        node->num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left) + getNumTotal(node->right);
        node->num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left);
    }

    void _rotateLeft(TreeNode* node) {
        if (!node->parent) {
            _tree = node->right;
            node->right->parent = nullptr;
        } else if (_isLeft(node)) {
            node->parent->left = node->right;
            node->right->parent = node->parent;
        } else {
            node->parent->right = node->right;
            node->right->parent = node->parent;
        }
        TreeNode* bk = node->right->left;
        node->right->left = node;
        node->parent = node->right;
        node->right = bk;
        if (bk) bk->parent = node;
        node->height = max(getHeight(node->left), getHeight(node->right)) + 1;
        node->num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left) + getNumTotal(node->right);
        node->num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left);
    }

public:
    AvlTree() : _tree(nullptr) {}

    void add(int k, int v) {
        if (!_tree) {
            _tree = new TreeNode(k, v);
            return;
        }
        TreeNode* node = _add(k, v);
        if (node) _rebalance(node);
    }

    void remove(int k) {
        TreeNode* node = _getNode(k);
        if (!node) return;
        if (_isLeaf(node)) {
            _removeLeaf(node);
            return;
        }
        if (node->left && node->right) {
            TreeNode* nxt = _getNext(node);
            node->key = nxt->key;
            node->value = nxt->value;
            if (_isLeaf(nxt)) {
                _removeLeaf(nxt);
            } else {
                _removeOne(nxt);
            }
            _rebalance(node);
        } else {
            _removeOne(node);
        }
    }

    int get(int k) {
        TreeNode* node = _getNode(k);
        return node ? node->value : -1;
    }

    pair<int,int> getAt(int pos) {
        int x = pos + 1;
        TreeNode* node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (x < node->num_left) {
                node = node->left;
            } else if (node->num_left < x) {
                x -= node->num_left;
                node = node->right;
            } else {
                return {node->key, node->value};
            }
        }
        throw out_of_range("Out of ranges");
    }
};

// Segment Tree (min version)
class SegmentTree1 {
private:
    int _default;
    function<int(int,int)> _func;
    int _len, _size;
    vector<int> data;
public:
    SegmentTree1(const vector<int>& arr, int default_val = 'z', function<int(int,int)> func = [](int a, int b){ return min(a,b); })
        : _default(default_val), _func(func), _len(arr.size()) {
        _size = 1; while (_size < _len) _size <<= 1;
        data.assign(2 * _size, default_val);
        for (int i = 0; i < _len; ++i) data[_size + i] = arr[i];
        for (int i = _size - 1; i > 0; --i) data[i] = _func(data[2*i], data[2*i+1]);
    }

    void set(int idx, int value) {
        idx += _size;
        data[idx] = value;
        idx >>= 1;
        while (idx) {
            data[idx] = _func(data[2*idx], data[2*idx+1]);
            idx >>= 1;
        }
    }

    int query(int start, int stop) {
        if (start == stop) return get(start);
        stop += 1;
        start += _size; stop += _size;
        int res = _default;
        while (start < stop) {
            if (start & 1) { res = _func(res, data[start]); start++; }
            if (stop & 1) { stop--; res = _func(res, data[stop]); }
            start >>= 1; stop >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    int get(int idx) { return data[idx + _size]; }
    int len() { return _len; }
};

// Factorial and Combination (mod)
class Factorial {
private:
    int MOD;
    vector<long long> factorials, invModulos, invFactorial_;
public:
    Factorial(int mod) : MOD(mod) {
        factorials = {1, 1};
        invModulos = {0, 1};
        invFactorial_ = {1, 1};
    }

    long long calc(int n) {
        if (n < 0) exit(1);
        if (n < (int)factorials.size()) return factorials[n];
        int initialI = factorials.size();
        factorials.resize(n+1);
        long long prev = factorials.back();
        for (int i = initialI; i <= n; ++i) {
            prev = factorials[i] = prev * i % MOD;
        }
        return factorials[n];
    }

    long long inv(int n) {
        if (n < 0) exit(1);
        long long p = MOD;
        int pi = n % p;
        if (pi < (int)invModulos.size()) return invModulos[pi];
        int initialI = invModulos.size();
        invModulos.resize(min((long long)n, p-1) + 1);
        for (int i = initialI; i <= min((long long)n, p-1); ++i) {
            long long next = -invModulos[p % i] * (p / i) % p;
            if (next < 0) next += p;
            invModulos[i] = next;
        }
        return invModulos[pi];
    }

    long long invFactorial(int n) {
        if (n < 0) exit(1);
        if (n < (int)invFactorial_.size()) return invFactorial_[n];
        inv(n);
        int initialI = invFactorial_.size();
        invFactorial_.resize(n+1);
        long long prev = invFactorial_.back();
        for (int i = initialI; i <= n; ++i) {
            prev = invFactorial_[i] = (prev * invModulos[i % MOD]) % MOD;
        }
        return invFactorial_[n];
    }
};

class Combination {
private:
    Factorial factorial;
public:
    Combination(int MOD) : factorial(MOD) {}
    long long ncr(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || n < k) return 0;
        k = min(k, n - k);
        return factorial.calc(n) * factorial.invFactorial(max(n-k, k)) % factorial.MOD * factorial.invFactorial(min(k, n-k)) % factorial.MOD;
    }
};

long long powm(long long a, long long n, long long m) {
    if (a == 1 || n == 0) return 1;
    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        long long s = powm(a, n/2, m);
        return s * s % m;
    } else {
        return a * powm(a, n-1, m) % m;
    }
}

int binarySearchCount(const vector<int>& arr, int n, int key) {
    int left = 0, right = n-1;
    int count = 0;
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] <= key) {
            count = mid + 1;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        a[i] %= k;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        cout << a[0] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int mid = n / 2;
    vector<int> l1(a.begin(), a.begin() + mid);
    vector<int> l2(a.begin() + mid, a.end());
    
    unordered_set<int> s, s1, s2;
    for (int i = 0; i < mid; ++i) {
        for (int x : s) {
            s2.insert((x + l1[i]) % k);
        }
        s.insert(l1[i]);
        for (int x : s2) {
            s.insert(x);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)l2.size(); ++i) {
        for (int x : s1) {
            s2.insert((x + l2[i]) % k);
        }
        s1.insert(l2[i]);
        for (int x : s2) {
            s1.insert(x);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }
    
    vector<int> sv(s.begin(), s.end());
    vector<int> s1v(s1.begin(), s1.end());
    sort(sv.begin(), sv.end());
    sort(s1v.begin(), s1v.end());
    
    int ans = max(sv.back(), s1v.back());
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)sv.size(); ++i) {
        int t = k - 1 - sv[i];
        int ind = binarySearchCount(s1v, s1v.size(), t);
        int r = s1v[ind - 1];
        int rt = s1v.back();
        int cur = max((r + sv[i]) % k, (sv[i] + rt) % k);
        ans = max(ans, cur);
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
